warnings: Second building of the set (section 11a): the 3-sheet 'แบบอาคารส่วนต่อเติม โรงอาหาร 101ล./27 (พิเศษ)' (หน้า 02-04) — a single-storey strip 32.00 x 2.50 with its own printed grid bubbles 1-10 and A-B (2.00 / 4.00 x 7 / 2.00). It reuses the names 1-10 / A-B of the main building's assigned grid at different spacings, so it has its own master and every extension file points here through grid_source.

Only the two printed rows A and B are named. The beam lines B2, B3 (counter / drain) and the second R2 line between A and B, carry no printed dimension: their positions are scaled from the 2.50 A-B bay (per-line flags). The B1 line beyond row B is placed at 1.50 from row B by the B5/1 beam elevation on sheet 3/3 (scaled from the plan ≈1.40); the same elevation prints B5 = 2.90 although the plan prints A-B = 2.50 twice — the plan wins for grid geometry (op01 precedence 1), the 2.90 is kept in the section file. ขยายเคาน์เตอร์ 1:20 prints the counter 0.80 wide and the drain 0.25 wide, consistent with the scaled 0.75 / 1.00.
The first pass did not sweep sheet หน้า02 (แผ่นที่ 1/3) for levels (time limit) and left z_levels[] empty — done in the second op04 pass (2026-10-22), see the next warnings.

Second op04 pass (2026-10-22): sheet หน้า02 (แผ่นที่ 1/3) swept tick by tick and the footing sections of หน้า04 swept for z. The first pass had left z_levels[] as an empty array with a 'not swept (time limit)' warning; it now holds the extension's own levels with ระดับดินเดิม (printed on the footing sections) as the datum — the elevations and sections of sheet 1/3 print no level marks, only chains standing on the same ground line.

x: the roof plan prints 1.15 eaves beyond grids 1 and 10 (overall 34.30) while the floor plan prints the 1.10 end boxes (overall 34.20) — the eave lines -1.15 / 33.15 sit 0.05 outside the box lines -1.10 / 33.10. Two different edges, both printed, so both kept as lines (section 4 rule 4: within 0.05 m → keep both and say so); -1.15 takes 1' and the box line becomes 1'' (gridfix re-sequence).

y: the floor plan's left row prints 1.10 / 1.40 / 1.50 = 4.00 (A → 1.10 → B → the B1 line) — this confirms the 2.50 A-B and the 1.50 B → B1 line that the first pass had to take from the B5/1 elevation; the B1 line is now a printed position. The new 1.10 tick (corridor / counter edge) sits 0.10 below the scaled B3 line (≈1.00) — it may be the same counter edge measured to a face, but the 1.00 line was never printed, so both stay. The two 0.70 / 0.80 rows beside the cubicles put a tick at 3.20 (B + 0.70).
op_fix/gridfix: x tick at -1.15 is within 0.05 m of existing ["1'"] but not the same point -- kept both (section 4 rule 4)
op_fix/gridfix: x tick at 33.15 is within 0.05 m of existing ["10'"] but not the same point -- kept both (section 4 rule 4)

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- 1' -> 1'', B' -> B''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names
